components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            prefixed to the last name to form the response-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Stored and
            returned normalized, and appended to 'addressLine1' (single space) to form 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as flat input for backward compatibility
            when no structured 'addressLine1' is supplied. Always returned as the composed,
            normalized address: 'addressLine1' with the normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a
            single space when present, otherwise the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or international form
            (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); stored and returned in E.164 form,
            assuming country code +61 when none is supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for
            the city's region using the fixed city-to-region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's age band (see 'ageBand') as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. An additional owner in a household (same last name and postcode) reachable
            on a different telephone is always created; when this is true the owner is recorded as a
            declared household member rather than being flagged a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identifiers, grouped together. Each mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so
        no value produced under version 1 is ever reproduced; the tag stays inside these identifiers and
        never appears in the user-facing locality, timezone or owner segment.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member id
          description: >-
            The owner's member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the version-2 region
            code, i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else 'UNKNOWN')
            prefixed with the 'V2' version tag; FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the
            business-day-adjusted registration date; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
            SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn
            check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW261A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            Deterministic identifier of the owner's household: the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256
            over the 'V2'-version-tagged normalized last name and postcode, so owners with the same last
            name and postcode share it automatically. Absent for an owner without a postcode.
          type: string
          example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through: the lower-case SHA-256
            hex digest of the 'V2'-version-tagged '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
            Two owners collide only when their whole identity keys are equal.
          type: string
          example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical REST path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string

## Summary

Released **version 2 of the owner identity**. The design keeps the codebase's existing philosophy — the `memberId` remains the single canonical identity that `locality`/`timezone`/`ownerSegment` derive from — while confining the `V2` tag to the identifiers.

### New single source of truth
- **`model/IdentityVersion.java`** — holds the fixed `TAG = "V2"` and `API_VERSION = 2`, plus three small helpers: `taggedRegion` (region inside identifiers), `plainRegion` (strip the tag for client-facing use), and `taggedInput` (mix the tag into a hash input). Every version-2 rule flows through this one class.

### Identity derivation (all identifiers now change, no v1 value reproduced)
- **`MemberId.of`** embeds `taggedRegion(region)` → e.g. `V2NSW261A2B3C4D5`. **`MemberId.regionOf`** strips the tag on read-back, so `locality` stays plain `NSW`.
- **`Household.idFor`** and **`Owner.getIdentityKey`** hash the `V2`-tagged input.
- Because the tag is a literal prefix, a v2 identifier can never coincide with its v1 form.

### User-facing fields stay plain
`getLocality` (tag-stripped from the memberId), `getTimezone`, and `getOwnerSegment` continue to use the plain region — the `V2` tag never leaks into them.

### Response shape (`openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper`)
- New `OwnerIdentity` schema groups `memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId`; these were removed from the top level and now live under a nested `identity` object.
- Added a top-level integer `apiVersion` of `2`.
- MapStruct populates both via a small `toOwnerIdentityDto` method and an `apiVersion` expression bound to `IdentityVersion.API_VERSION`.

### Audit schema (`OwnerCreatedEvent`)
Moved to schema version 2: added `schemaVersion = 2` and the recomputed `ownerSegment` (sourced from `owner.getOwnerSegment()`, which uses the plain region).

Request fields are untouched. `./mvnw test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0`. The audit log confirms the behavior end-to-end: `memberId=V2NSW2716E6609E7`, `{"schemaVersion":2,...,"ownerSegment":"STANDARD_METRO",...}` (METRO confirms locality resolved to the plain `NSW`).
